title: Mobile Wallet Tier Matrix: Entry Levels, Funding Methods and Corridors
content:
Each Mobile Wallet tier sets who may book it, how it may be paid for and where it credits wallets. The figures below are the tier parameters of the Mobile Wallet product; every tier is listed.

## Entry and funding by tier

| Tier | Lowest Personal Sender Account level | Completed personal transfers needed | Funding methods the tier accepts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | Paloma Starter | 0 | debit card, pay-by-bank |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | Paloma Starter | 0 | ACH debit |
| Mobile Wallet Express | Paloma Starter | 0 | debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | Paloma Verified Plus | 5 | debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | Paloma Verified | 0 | debit card, pay-by-bank |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | Paloma Enhanced | 5 | wire, pay-by-bank |

- **Lowest account level** is the lowest Personal Sender Account level that may book the tier.
- **Completed personal transfers needed** is the fewest completed personal transfers the customer must already have before booking the tier (a count).
- **Funding methods** are those the tier accepts; the level of the customer's Personal Sender Account may narrow the list further.

## Corridors, wallet providers and stated purpose

| Tier | Corridors served | Corridors where a transfer purpose must be stated | Provider's registered wallet name checked before the credit is sent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | PH-PHP, KE-KES, GH-GHS, BD-BDT, CO-COP, GT-GTQ, HN-HNL | BD-BDT | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | PH-PHP, KE-KES, GH-GHS, BD-BDT, CO-COP, GT-GTQ, HN-HNL | BD-BDT | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express | PH-PHP, KE-KES, GH-GHS, BD-BDT, CO-COP, GT-GTQ, HN-HNL | BD-BDT | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | PH-PHP, KE-KES, GH-GHS, BD-BDT, CO-COP, GT-GTQ, HN-HNL | BD-BDT | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | PH-PHP, KE-KES, GH-GHS, BD-BDT, CO-COP, GT-GTQ, HN-HNL | BD-BDT | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | PH-PHP, KE-KES, BD-BDT | PH-PHP, KE-KES, BD-BDT | yes |

Wallet providers Paloma credits in each corridor (the same on every tier that serves the corridor):

| Corridor | Wallet providers credited |
|---|---|
| PH-PHP | GCash, Maya |
| KE-KES | M-Pesa |
| GH-GHS | MTN MoMo |
| BD-BDT | bKash |
| CO-COP | Nequi |
| GT-GTQ | Tigo Money |
| HN-HNL | Tigo Money |

## Reading the matrix (hypothetical examples)

- *Hypothetical:* a customer whose Personal Sender Account is at Paloma Verified Plus and who has 5 completed personal transfers meets the entry figures of Mobile Wallet Express Plus; the same customer with 4 completed transfers does not, because the tier needs at least 5.
- *Hypothetical:* a Ghana corridor (GH-GHS) wallet can be credited on Mobile Wallet Micro, Economy, Express, Express Plus or Priority, always through MTN MoMo; Mobile Wallet Large Amount does not serve GH-GHS.
- *Hypothetical:* a Mobile Wallet Economy transfer can only be paid by ACH debit; a card or pay-by-bank payment is not among that tier's funding methods.
